mapper.insert: insert into receipt_writeoff (corpid, writeoff_no, receipt_id, receivable_id, writeoff_date, amount, status, remark, creator_id, modify_id, del, add_time, update_time) values (#{corpid}, #{writeoffNo}, #{receiptId}, #{receivableId}, #{writeoffDate}, #{amount}, 1, #{remark}, #{creatorId}, #{modifyId}, #{del}, #{addTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select w.id, w.corpid, r.customer_id, w.writeoff_no, w.receipt_id, w.receivable_id, w.writeoff_date, w.amount, w.status, w.reversed_time, w.remark, w.creator_id, w.modify_id from receipt_writeoff w join receipt r on r.id = w.receipt_id and r.corpid = w.corpid where w.corpid = #{corpid} and w.id = #{id} and w.del = 0

select id, corpid, writeoff_no, receipt_id, receivable_id, writeoff_date, amount, status, reversed_time, remark, creator_id, modify_id from receipt_writeoff where corpid = #{corpid} and receipt_id = #{receiptId} and del = 0 and status = 1
select count(1) from receipt_writeoff where corpid = #{conditionMap.corpid} and del = 0
